body:
Faces stalled supplies at the forge while trying to protect his daughter from the mist.

Recorded role and choices

In the April 2026 scene at Herb’s tavern, Gulen says his supplies have not arrived and that the forge has been cold for three days. He tries to stop Thera from pursuing what she believes is her mother’s voice and explains that her mother died during the siege. His guess about the cause of the mist remains a guess, and Thera’s report does not establish that her mother has returned.
